source-checked.eventDescription: One valid public source check (one profile/Page/company), $2 per 1,000 checks. Paid when filters, exclusions or a valid empty/not-found response leave zero rows. Failed or blocked responses and invalid input are not charged. No start fee; proxy and compute are included. maxSources limits attempted targets. maxTotalChargeUsd is the Apify run option for a dollar cap, not an input field.

company.eventDescription: One delivered company; row keys name, industry, company_size, headquarters, website, followers, linkedin_members_count. $2 per 1,000 rows plus the source-check fee. Filtered, duplicate and excluded rows have no row fee. No start fee; proxy and compute are included. One checked profile with one row costs $0.004 total.
